page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top centre ("Jo. Morinus") with page number at top left. Catchword "con-" at lower right below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.p: tionem non amplectebatur. Recte eqvi-dem interpretaris [?]יוצא מן ההקשה egré-dieris ab analogia, sed [?]יועאמו & [?]בחלוף non video qva ratione idem significare dici possint. Deinde illud prius optime textui convenit, in qvo agitur de Grammaticationibus heteroclitis, sed qvod legatur צרן vel צרן varia lectio, non grammaticatio, in qva semper aliqvid regulam non servat. Nihil enim in צרן vel צרן irregulare est.

Nunc tamen textum pei pendens facile existimarim [?]ההקשה legendum & secundum litteram esse vocis formativam, & interpretandum, rationem opinionem: ideo [?]בחלוף ההקשה significare cum permutatione sive varietate rationis, hoc est, qvid dices, cum littera reperitur in libris cum variante ratione, id est, ubi ratio de utraqve lectione reddi potest. Hanc interpretationem confirmare videtur id qvod sequitur, si in ejusmodi dominatur [?]ההקשה, ratio, id est, si ratio & opinio propria dominatur, &c. Ita interpres intellexit. Verum si oculo amico ista

page.notes: Hebrew words are transcribed from the scan and are uncertain, especially the second and third Hebrew words of the first line and the word after "ideo"; they are marked [?]. The Hebrew forms "צרן" in the middle of the page are read as printed but may be slightly off. The word "pei" (line 1 of the second paragraph) is printed as shown. The catchword "con-" is the last word of the page's text and is not repeated in the text. Stray marks at the top right and the bottom edge are not printed text and are omitted.
